headline: Speak it.
Believe it.
Watch it unfold.
paras: In 1928, the New York artist and teacher Florence Scovel Shinn gathered the words that had changed her students’ lives: short, joyful, fearless affirmations for success, love, money, forgiveness, guidance and health.
Almost a century later, her little book still speaks. This annotated edition keeps every word of the original and adds what today’s reader needs to put it into practice.
